note: Names of the modifiers that speak of stores, Stored Essence, workshops, forges, yards, roads, trade and Craft Efficiency. Modifier names that nest a building or resource key ($infrastructure$ and the like) follow the building and resource names without being written here. The building speed and repair names, and the resource families, are generated from data/economy.json. Licence, lend-lease, agent and warfare modifiers belong to their own modules.
